preconditions.description: The length of the mask m is between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the mask m is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ['#', '_'] for c in m)
preconditions.description: The mask m consists only of '#' and '_' characters.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 indicating no valid profile exists, or a non-negative integer k representing the number of integers in the profile p', followed by k integers separated by spaces representing the profile p'.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (isinstance(output, int) and output >= 0 and isinstance(output[1], list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output[1]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it includes a list of integers where each integer represents a part of the profile p'.
